themes_detail.label: Electrical hazards surge
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints spiked to 3 this week versus a 0.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 1100% increase with z-score 6.35—signaling potential widespread wiring failures or fire hazards in Crown Heights/Prospect Heights buildings.
evidence: 3 electrical complaints this week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
508 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (316 alterations), suggesting active construction that may involve electrical work
Community Board has repeatedly requested additional building inspectors—unfunded request indicating capacity gap in oversight
reporting_angles: Are contractors conducting unpermitted or substandard electrical work during the recent alteration surge?
Interview DOB about staffing levels and inspection frequency for electrical work in the district

themes_detail.label: Street sanitation deteriorates rapidly
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints jumped to 100 this week versus a 51.4 weekly average (95% increase, z-score 5.92) and street condition complaints hit 40 this week versus 9.1 average (338% spike, z-score 4.91), indicating acute cleanliness and pavement problems emerging this week.
evidence: 100 unsanitary condition complaints this week vs. 51.4 weekly average (95% spike, z-score 5.92)
40 street condition complaints this week vs. 9.1 weekly average (338% spike, z-score 4.91)
Community Board ongoing budget requests for park improvements and facilities suggest prior neglect
reporting_angles: Map the geographic clusters of complaints—are certain blocks or commercial corridors hit harder?
Interview DSNY about collection schedules and staffing changes that may explain the rapid deterioration

themes_detail.label: Commercial noise complaints double
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints surged to 45 this week versus a 19.6 weekly average (129% increase, z-score 5.0), representing a sharp spike this week in complaints about bars, restaurants, or other commercial operations in the district.
evidence: 45 commercial noise complaints this week vs. 19.6 weekly average (129% spike, z-score 5.0)
Noise - Residential complaints also remain elevated at 1,152 over 90 days (third-largest complaint category)
No Reddit discussions or recent news coverage yet, suggesting emerging rather than widely-reported issue
reporting_angles: Which venues or blocks are generating the spike—late-night bars, restaurants with outdoor seating, or events?
Have NYPD enforcement or licensing actions changed recently, or are residents finally mobilizing complaints?

themes_detail.label: For-hire vehicle complaints triple
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints jumped to 30 last week versus a 7.1 weekly average (321% increase, z-score 5.84), indicating a sharp spike in Uber, Lyft, or other app-based taxi complaints in the district last week.
evidence: 30 for-hire vehicle complaints last week vs. 7.1 weekly average (321% spike, z-score 5.84)
Illegal parking complaints remain second-largest category at 2,174 over 90 days, suggesting congestion and vehicle enforcement issues
Atlantic Ave FRESH Pt. 2 development proposal in early stages—may attract increased commercial traffic and rideshare activity
reporting_angles: Are complaints concentrated on specific corridors (Atlantic Ave, Nostrand, etc.) or related to specific services?
Interview TLC and residents about the nature of complaints—illegal parking, double-parking, driver behavior, noise?

themes_detail.label: Animals abandoned in parks
themes_detail.summary: Animal-in-park complaints spiked to 6 last week versus a 0.6 weekly average (860% increase, z-score 6.27), suggesting abandoned, lost, or threatening animals appearing in district parks this week and representing a public safety concern.
evidence: 6 animal-in-park complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average (860% spike, z-score 6.27)
Community Board has ongoing requests for park improvements and facility upgrades
No recent news or Reddit coverage of animal issues, suggesting emerging local story
reporting_angles: What types of animals and which parks are involved—dogs, rodents, wildlife? Are these abandoned pets or strays?
Interview Parks Department and animal control about response capacity and any recent enforcement gaps
